tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are a student organizing a study group for an upcoming exam. You want to invite your classmates to join the group and explain to them your ideas about how the group should proceed.
Write an email to your classmates. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the study group.
Describe the topics you plan to cover during the study sessions and other ideas you have for the sessions.
Suggest a time and location for the first meeting
tasks.to: Classmates Subject: Invitation to join study group
tasks.subject: Invitation to join study group
tasks.title: Write an Email
